mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_page_view_log ( agent_code, visitor_id, ip_address, user_agent, referer, device_type, visit_time ) VALUES ( #{agentCode}, #{visitorId}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{referer}, #{deviceType}, #{visitTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as todayViews, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as todayVisitors, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) as todayIps, COUNT(CASE WHEN device_type = 'Mobile' THEN 1 END) as mobileViews, COUNT(CASE WHEN device_type = 'PC' THEN 1 END) as pcViews, MAX(visit_time) as lastVisitTime FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_page_view_log ( agent_code, visitor_id, ip_address, user_agent, referer, device_type, visit_time ) VALUES
( #{item.agentCode}, #{item.visitorId}, #{item.ipAddress}, #{item.userAgent}, #{item.referer}, #{item.deviceType}, #{item.visitTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT HOUR(visit_time) as visitHour, COUNT(*) as totalViews, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY HOUR(visit_time) ORDER BY visitHour

SELECT device_type as deviceType, COUNT(*) as viewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = CURDATE()), 2) as percentage FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY viewCount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN referer IS NULL OR referer = '' THEN '直接访问' ELSE referer END as refererSource, COUNT(*) as viewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY referer ORDER BY viewCount DESC LIMIT 10
